## Multi-Service Health Dashboard
Pings multiple service health endpoints every 5 minutes in parallel, checks responses, logs uptime to Sheets, and alerts Slack + Email if any service is down.

**Setup:**
1. Replace service URLs in the HTTP Request nodes
2. Add/remove HTTP Request nodes for more/fewer services
3. Update the services array in the Code node to match
4. Connect Google Sheets for uptime logging
5. Set Slack channel and Gmail recipient for alerts
